content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad offer convenience—until they don’t. They handle payment processing, product delivery, and customer management in exchange for fees and control. Sovereign commerce stacks, by contrast, use GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase to give you full ownership. No platform fees. No account suspensions. No geographic restrictions. You deploy once, own forever. The tradeoff? You manage the infrastructure. But in regions where platforms reject you, ownership is not optional.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on financial regulations, perceived risk, or political factors. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy rely on these processors, inheriting their restrictions. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. By using NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you accept 300+ currencies with no KYC. Buyers pay on-chain. You receive payment directly. The system is not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative built on open infrastructure. If your country is restricted, platforms are not your solution.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. PayPal holds funds for months in restricted regions. Sovereign stacks use NOWPayments at 0.5% per transaction. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes. No chargebacks. No frozen funds. Recommended networks like BSC and Solana keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost? Time to deploy. But once live, your stack operates without platform taxes. In regions where platforms extract or exclude, owning your infrastructure is cheaper long-term.
Platforms exclude countries. Sovereign stacks exclude no one.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms own your data, control your access, and can suspend your account. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. Cloudflare Workers automate order processing. Supabase stores order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files instantly. Once deployed, the system runs without COREMERCH or any third party. You own the code, the data, and the process. The tradeoff? You must configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email delivery. But in exchange, no platform can shut you down.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a Stripe-supported country with low risk tolerance, platforms may suffice. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, or similar regions, platforms are not an option. Sovereign commerce stacks are the only permanent solution. Start with the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) if you need Cloudflare-grade infrastructure deployed in 48 hours. Choose the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) if you prefer to build yourself. The decision is not about convenience—it’s about whether you want to rent or own your commerce infrastructure.

You own the entire system, eliminating the risk of account suspensions or fund holds. Recommended for sellers in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and other restricted regions.

Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your sovereign commerce stack by first setting up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site for storefront hosting. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Configure webhooks to automate order fulfillment.
